assessments.reasoning: The hash-matched IEEE SA heading identifies IEEE 1076-2019 as the VHDL language reference manual. The main description explicitly expands VHDL and says it is the language defined by the standard. The exact description excerpt also reproduced its registered hash.

challenge.method: Compare the standard heading and description with the separate IEEE 1076.1-2017 catalog and the VHDL Analysis and Standardization Group edition list. Test whether the described subject is a tool, an AMS extension, or the base language.
challenge.results: The name in the 1076-2019 catalog denotes the language. IEEE 1076.1-2017 describes VHDL-AMS as a distinct extension based on 1076-2008. The conclusion makes no inference about that extension.

limitations: The publisher's catalog establishes language identity and the edition reference. Edition syntax and implementation behavior require applicable governing or empirical evidence. Active is an index status.
